name: leultew/lead-governance-airlock
category: B. Vertical Workflow Templates (RevOps: Lead-to-Opportunity Enrichment)
description: Governed inbound lead enrichment, deduplication, and AE dispatch workflow with airlock approval gate, saga rollbacks, and Ed25519 tamper-evident receipts.

nodes.description: Sanitizes input, verifies RFC 5322 syntax, and rejects disposable email domains
Evaluates SHA-256 idempotency fingerprint against dual-layer memory and SQLite state to prevent duplicate processing
Computes ICP score (0-100), assigns account tier (Enterprise/Mid-Market/SMB), and determines assigned AE
Stages structured before/after diffs for operator approval or automated policy sign-off
Creates or updates Contact and Deal in HubSpot CRM with 429 exponential backoff
Dispatches Block Kit priority alert card to AE Slack channel with 1-click CRM deal link
Appends audit record to secondary Airtable telemetry base
Mints cryptographic Ed25519 signed receipt with non-tampered SHA-256 state root
